title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Everyone gets a turn
hook: Has every player on your team had a turn at catcher?
statement: Key positions teach things no other spot can.
q1: Do you rotate every player through key positions —
q2: or keep those spots for the kids who fit them?
q3: Who has never asked but might like it?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids understand the game
t2: when they see it from every spot.
cta: Coaches — who plays the key positions?
ctaLines: Everyone rotates. Volunteers only. Set players.
ctaPrompt: Share your lineup habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Has every player on your team had a turn at catcher?
The same kid always catches. Others have never tried it.
Key positions teach things no other spot can.
Rotate key positions or keep them set. Every team is different.
Who plays the key positions? Share your habit in the comments.
